target.removed_nonpolymer: waters, glycans, ions, ligands - none present in this crystal form

hotspots.evidence: All six are in the avelumab (PD-1-competitive) footprint on PD-L1 in 5GRJ at <4.5 A, and all are solvent-exposed (SASA 25-113 A^2)

design_parameters.rationale: Protein Binder Design schema has no num_designs field; 3 independent runs with distinct seeds give 3 de novo candidates. compare_binder=1 enables sequence design + complex structure prediction on the hallucinated backbone.
